name: Chiral Axis Test Fixture
description: Permanent axis/handedness verification fixture (owner amendment 2, T2). Base box 20x12x9 in with a 4x4x2 in boss on top, offset toward +x/+y. Distinct extents on all three axes; the off-centre boss has no mirror symmetry, so a handedness flip (which passes every bounds/dimension check) is detectable. Expected overall bounds: 20 x 12 x 11 in (0.508 x 0.3048 x 0.2794 m). All dims are exact inch multiples so job cards can use round inches.
